title: Money
description: Represents an immutable monetary amount in integer minor units with explicit ISO 4217 currency. Supports both canonical camelCase ('amountInMinorUnits') and legacy snake_case ('amount_minor_units'), plus 'decimalString' for lossless serialization beyond JavaScript's safe integer boundary.

amountInMinorUnits.description: Canonical amount in the currency's smallest subunit (e.g., 100.50 EGP is 10050 piasters).

decimalString.description: Exact decimal string representation (e.g. '100.50'). Guarantees lossless transmission when amount exceeds 2^53 - 1.
